verdict.rationale: Superpowers is driven entirely through conversation inside the host agent. Skills auto-trigger from plain requests, for example "Fix this bug" routes to systematic-debugging (docs-77, gh-11, docs-16). Brainstorming teases out a spec through chat (gh-1, gh-16, docs-68, docs-71), and saying "go" launches implementation (gh-18). Community users confirm the conversational brainstorm/plan/implement workflow and just telling it to go (comm-2, comm-3); slash commands are an optional shortcut (docs-18, docs-20). Missing for 10: hands-on runtime verification that natural-language auto-triggering works reliably, since the author hedges that it "should" default to planning (docs-9) and the probe only verified installation.
